title: fix(plugin-security): explain answers a by-id write of a row the caller cannot read with the nonexistent id's whole answer, layers included
body:
Fixes #22761

Clause-②: no

It narrows what explain's layers say about a row the caller cannot read to what the door already answers. No accepted input changes and no public type moves.

## What changed

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts`, the read-absent rewrite in `explainAccess` only. The read-absent question is now asked before the record story is written. A row the caller cannot read is then attributed through the same path as an id no row carries. The record verdict, every row-scoped layer's `record` block and the tenant layer's verdict all come from that one path. Before, only the record verdict was replaced, after the layers had been written.
- The guard now reads the gate inputs (`capsDeny`, `crudAllowed`) directly. It used to read the decider names the attribution had written. The cases it admits are the ones the comment always named: past the capability and object CRUD gates, for a principal with an identity, for `rlsOp` `update` or `delete`.
- No change to any door, to `masterWriteCheckRefusal`, to `applyRecordAttribution` or to any layer's own logic. The edit reaches the `applyRecordAttribution` call that opens the same `if (input.recordId)` block, a few lines above the cited range, because the question now comes before that call.

## Measurement first

Measured at `origin/main` `e84aeb36c` with the real `SecurityPlugin` over a real `ObjectQL`, the SQL driver and the real `SharingService` middleware. The cases were `update`, `delete` and `transfer` on a `controlled_by_parent` detail:

- (a) a row the caller cannot read;
- (b) an id no row carries;
- (c) CONTROL: a readable row whose master the caller may not edit.

Results:

- **Doors:** (a) and (b) both answered `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, and (c) answered `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, for all three verbs.
- **Record verdict:** (a) and (b) were identical, the missing-record shape.
- **Layers: (a) and (b) were NOT identical, and the difference was not one sentence.** All six row-scoped layers' `record` blocks differed: `tenant_isolation`, `owd_baseline`, `depth`, `sharing`, `vama_bypass` and `rls`.
  - All six differed in `detail`.
  - `owd_baseline` and `sharing` also differed in `outcome` and `matchesRecord`, and `owd_baseline` in its `rules`.
  - `tenant_isolation`, `sharing` and `rls` also carried a `rowFilter` key that (b) does not.
  - The object-level fields (`allowed`, `principal`, each layer's own `verdict`, `detail` and `contributors`) were identical.
  - So the layers told (a) from (b): the existence bit the door withholds. The `sharing` record named the master check's 403 beside the door's 404.
- After the fix, (a) and (b) are equal field by field for all three verbs, and (c) is unchanged.

## Pins (`explain-read-absent-record-story.test.ts`, 16 cases)

- Armed: the subject rows exist under a system read, the caller's read returns none of them, and the caller reads every control row.
- Per verb: (a)'s whole explanation equals (b)'s, with only the record id set aside. Both doors answer `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` with status 404 (`code` and `status` asserted), and the record verdict is still the missing-record shape.
- Per verb: every status any layer names equals the status the door gives.
- Per verb, CONTROL (c): the door answers `PERMISSION_DENIED` with status 403, the record verdict is unchanged (`visible: false`, `decidedBy: 'sharing'`), the `sharing` record is `excluded` and names the master check's leg, and the only status any layer names is the door's 403.
- Per verb, at the engine level: a stored row behind the tenant wall that the read does not return is explained exactly as the id no row carries. CONTROL: the same deps bag without the read question reaches the wall's own refusal. The detail objects above are not tenant-scoped, so this is the case that reaches the tenant layer's verdict.

## Ablation (one-time proof, no permanent file)

The old behaviour was put back with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the attribution read the stored row, and the record verdict was replaced afterwards.

- The anchor hit 1 time, then 0, and the blob went from `f0f52a3c` to `4ac19bb4`.
- Run at `02f40a098`: **9 failed, 7 passed of 16**. The 9 are the negative pins: the equality pin, the status pin and the engine-level tenant pin, for each of the three verbs. The 7 are the armed case and the six controls.
- Quoted failures:
  - `AssertionError: a status named in explain update's layers: expected '403 PERMISSION_DENIED' to be '404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND'`
  - `AssertionError: expected { allowed: true, …(5) } to deeply equal { allowed: true, …(5) }`. The diff starts at the `tenant_isolation` record.
- Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` on the absolute path. The blob equals the HEAD blob `f0f52a3c`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- The test imports the engine through `src/` (relative imports), so no `dist/` leg applies.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at `4da36f554`: 199 files passed, 4030 tests passed, 45 skipped. The only commit since adds cases to the new test file. That file alone at `02f40a098`: 16 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` at `02f40a098`: exit 0. The test layer is included (`tsconfig.test.json` lists the new file).
- Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `02f40a098`: 66 derived. 63 were run, all exit 0. 3 are NOT MEASURED:
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs a whole-workspace build.
  - `check:i18n` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs the CLI and its extract closure built.
  - `check:type-check-debt`: its re-measure leg is a whole-workspace build plus every package's tsc. It was killed at the foreground cap at `4da36f554` and not re-run.
  - `--ran` reconciles 66 of 66, 0 UNRUN. CI runs all three.
- The three artifact-roster gates whose rosters sit under these paths all exit 0 at `02f40a098`: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`.
- Lint, narrowed to the two TypeScript files: eslint `--no-inline-config --format json` over 2 files reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. The repository's eslint config enables no type-aware linting: the resolved `parserOptions` are only `ecmaVersion` and `sourceType`, with no `project`. So this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- The old guard skipped the rewrite whenever the decider was `object_crud`. The attribution also writes that name on a `visible: true` verdict that no other layer decided. The new guard keys on the gate inputs, so that path is covered too if it is reachable. Whether any configuration reaches it is NOT MEASURED. The one route tried, an update policy on the master, is refused by the master check first.
- The read question is now also asked for an id no row carries, which costs one caller-context read per by-id write explanation of such an id. The answer is the same as before, by construction.
